notice_143_1_sample.txt.summary: An intimation under section 143(1)(a) proposing two adjustments to the AY 2025-26 return.
notice_143_1_sample.txt.why: The department's AIS shows deposit interest of ₹48,920 (194A) that the return didn't include, and the TDS claimed under 192 (₹2,30,000) is ₹5,000 more than Form 26AS shows (₹2,25,000).
what_to_do: Check the client's FD interest certificates for FY 2024-25 against the ₹48,920 in AIS.
Compare the employer's Form 16 TDS with 26AS; if the employer under-reported, ask them to revise their TDS return.
Respond on the e-filing portal by 11 Nov 2026: agree to the interest, and disagree on TDS with Form 16 if the employer corrects 26AS.
If the interest is agreed, file a revised return or accept the adjustment.
notice_143_1_sample.txt.draft_reply: With reference to the intimation under section 143(1)(a) for AY 2025-26 (DIN CPC/2526/A6/123456789): 1. I agree that interest of [amount] on deposits was omitted and accept the adjustment. 2. The TDS of ₹2,30,000 claimed is as per Form 16 issued by my employer; the difference of ₹5,000 arises because the employer has [to confirm: not yet revised] the TDS return. I request that the credit be allowed once Form 26AS is corrected.
quotes: Intimation under section 143(1)(a) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 - Proposed adjustment
The proposed adjustment may result in a demand of Rs. 19,840.
